method: CPU behavioral regression: shipped video/R247/R291/native serialization, synthetic DOM/media/timers. Not browser, GPU or natural play.

checks.name: Michaela W/E cannot cast behind the video
normal game W/E input still works after the overlay is gone
normal cut holds the title then removes the overlay and restores BGM
skip key "Escape" restores BGM and returns to game
skip key "Enter" restores BGM and returns to game
skip key " " restores BGM and returns to game
skip pointer removes the overlay once
skip button removes the overlay once
never-started media recovers by the startup deadline
post-start waiting cannot leave a permanent overlay or silent BGM
post-start stalled cannot leave a permanent overlay or silent BGM
post-start pause cannot leave a permanent overlay or silent BGM
post-start abort cannot leave a permanent overlay or silent BGM
continuous media progress keeps a long slow playback alive
the title hold is not mistaken for a paused-stream failure
explicit media error restores audio and starts exactly one fallback
autoplay rejection retries muted without changing user music settings
a rejected muted retry closes and starts the fallback
original user mute and zero BGM remain unchanged after cleanup
saving during the opening does not persist temporary BGM ducking
an independent nonzero BGM change wins over the old duck value
late old playing cannot affect a new session
late old error cannot affect a new session
late old ended cannot affect a new session
late old timeupdate cannot affect a new session
late play rejection cannot mute or close a newer video
late muted retry rejection cannot close the next session
closing fade still blocks input until the overlay disappears
media listeners are detached when their session closes
repeated play/close cycles leave no media roots or duplicate input guards
duplicate script evaluation cannot register another permanent guard
